correctness.rationale: The complete fiber law, survival probability, TV normalization and exact support statements in RESULT.md lines 3–41 and 43–78 check. Independent proof: put P=D/(q−1) and h=(H−1)/(q−1). A factor has an incident image line/kernel hyperplane (P h choices) and one of q−1 nonzero scales. Given its image line L and a proposed next image L′, exactly J=q^{n−2} hyperplanes through L exclude L′ if L≠L′, and zero if equal. The survival fraction per transition is therefore J(P−1)/(Ph)=λ/C. Conditional on all transitions surviving the initial image line is uniform, and the successive image lines take uniform steps to distinct lines (transition (ones−I)/(P−1)); the last kernel is uniform among the h hyperplanes through the last line, and the scalar of the product is uniform among q−1 choices since one uniformly random factor scale already suffices. This gives per-target conditional probability [h/P + (−1/(P−1))^{r−1}(1_{tr B=0}−h/P)]/[Ph(q−1)]. Multiplying by C λ^{r−1} gives both nonzero rank-one formulas including r=1. No rank≥2 is possible, and subtraction gives the zero count. The conditional signed deviation from uniform scales by (−1/(P−1))^{r−1} from r=1; at r=1 its TV is 1−h/P because the law is uniform on the trace-zero stratum. This yields the stated TV and alternating sign. At r=2 the trace-zero count H(J−1) vanishes exactly for n=2; each class is positive by r=3 and stays so because the transition has positive off-diagonal entries and a positive lower-right entry. Independent replay python /workspace/branches/independent_reproduction.py 4 checked all targets that can occur and exact conditional TV at each length 1–4 for n=2,3 over F2; the general proof uses finite projective counts and is not limited to prime fields. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed.
